## RAG - Process Source

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/rag-process-source

**Description:** Processes RAG sources (files/links) for indexation.
Receives webhooks from chatbot-core API after upload/link/retry.
Extracts text, chunks, vectorizes and stores in Qdrant.
Reports progress and completion back to API.

**Webhook Payload (from API):**
```json
{
  "action": "process" | "retry",
  "source_id": "src_xxx",
  "tenant_id": "Z6F3GSWB",
  "guild_id": "1286607696153546774",
  "bot_id": "987654321",
  "file_type": "pdf" | "txt" | "md" | "docx" | "xlsx" | "pptx" | "mp4" | "mp3" | "yt",
  "b2_file_key": "tenant/rag/guild/bot/src/file.pdf",
  "url": "https://youtube.com/...",
  "extraction_mode": "subtitles" | "whisper" | "metadata",
  "backend_api_url": "https://apidev.azy.solutions",
  "backend_service_token": "xxx"
}
```

**Callbacks to API:**
- POST /api/discord/n8n/sources/{source_id}/progress
- POST /api/discord/n8n/sources/{source_id}/complete
